documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in field services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in field services who is experiencing workflow disruption due to a recent configuration change. They explicitly state that this is a support incident and request that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The current stage is 'customer' with verified consent, and the account is not blocked.

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your request to involve support before any further discussion. Our support team is available to assist with resolving this issue and ensuring your system is running smoothly. Please let us know the best way to connect with your support representative.
questions: What is the current status of your support case?
Have you identified the specific configuration change that caused the workflow disruption?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change causing the workflow disruption is not specified.
